description: Status of a purchase started with book_dropin or join_gym (ref): pending (checkout open), processing (bank debit), paid, free or failed, and whether the gym now shows in the person's Gymmy account. The widget calls it by itself after the Stripe page opens; call it when the person says they paid or asks. The booking is confirmed by the gym's Stripe webhook either way.

ref.description: The ref returned by book_dropin or join_gym.

name: checkout_status
title: Payment status
